label.zh: 物种带有“灵能潜势”时随机发生（平均220个月）：非格式塔有机帝国
label.en: While the species is Latent Psionic, at random (MTTH 220 months): organic non-gestalt empire

bridges.evidence: events/utopia_on_action_events.txt:1568-1628 utopia.2605 hidden, mean_time_to_happen months = 220, requires owner_species is_latent_psionic_species and a same-species leader without psionic/chosen trait; immediate: is_robot_empire = no and is_gestalt = no -> 2606. 2600's option grants the latent psionic trait (1371-1373 tooltip add_latent_psionic_trait)

label.zh: 带有“灵能潜势”时随机发生：非格式塔机械帝国
label.en: While latent psionic, at random: machine non-gestalt empire

bridges.evidence: events/utopia_on_action_events.txt:1617-1622 utopia.2605 else_if is_robot_empire = yes, is_gestalt = no -> 2607

label.zh: 带有“灵能潜势”时随机发生：格式塔帝国（统治者）
label.en: While latent psionic, at random: gestalt empire (the ruler)

label.zh: 采纳“大觉醒”传统（需先有“灵能军团”与“读心术”）
label.en: Adopt the Great Awakening tradition (requires Psi Corps and Mind Readers)

bridges.evidence: common/traditions/01_psionics.txt:103-118 tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation possible = tr_psionics_psi_corps + tr_psionics_mind_readers; on_enabled fires utopia.2650; 1-23 tr_psionics_adopt fires utopia.2600

label.zh: 采纳突入虚境传统（见“虚境”）

bridges.evidence: common/traditions/01_psionics.txt:123-135 tr_psionics_breach_shroud possible = tr_psionics_psionic_assimilation; on_enabled fires utopia.2655

note.zh: 同一隐藏事件2605按帝国类型选择其一；只要仍有“灵能潜势”物种且有合格领袖，可多次发生。
note.en: The same hidden event 2605 picks one by empire type; it can repeat while a latent psionic species has an eligible leader.

scope.zh: 灵能传统线前两段：采纳灵能传统（心胜于物）、“灵能潜势”期间的随机灵能者、“大觉醒”传统及其对其他帝国的通知；“突入虚境”之后见“虚境”故事。
scope.en: The first two steps of the Psionics traditions: adopting them (Mind Over Matter), random psychics while latent psionic, the Great Awakening tradition and the notices to other empires; Breach the Shroud onwards is the story 'The Shroud'.

uncertain: utopia.2602 / 2652 and observer.5 / 6 are also fired by Shadows of the Shroud content (shroud.2750, shroud.8310, shroud.2780, shroud.2830) and appear in those stories as well.
